topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.7)
Board risk committee and audit committee oversee cyber risk quarterly; independent directors
Group CISO, division security leads, and internal audit reporting lines documented
Role-based training; background checks for privileged and payment roles
Control owners named in the common control catalog and division supplements; annual attestations
Asset and data inventories; SIEM and configuration data used for control operation

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Group policies published; quarterly security updates to division leadership
Service commitments to owners in management agreements and the responsibility matrix; owner notice of incidents
control_owner: Hotels senior vice president of owner relations
gap: No system description for owners; 31 pre-2020 management agreements have no written security commitments; the responsibility matrix has reached 23 of 41 ownership groups
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; side letters; matrix to all owners (POAM-026)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk management objectives and tolerance defined (P01)
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division (P01)
Fraud risk considered in the risk analysis (payment fraud, loyalty fraud, insider misuse)
Significant changes (acquisitions, new systems, vendor changes) assessed through the change and risk process
Annual common control assessment by group internal audit plus division samples (P07)
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the board committees

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk analysis and the SP 800-53 High baseline (P02)
General IT controls over identity, change, and operations (common controls)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies POL-01 to POL-05 and division supplements

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO, MFA, and PAM through SYS-G1; encryption with group key management
PMS and cloud POS accounts provisioned from SYS-G1 for owned and managed hotel staff; legacy POS local accounts created by outlet managers
gap: 112 legacy POS local accounts outside identity governance

control_description: PMS roles and card-display rights; integration accounts limited to needed fields
control_owner: Hotels division payments and systems director
evidence: P07 AC-6 results; PMS role export
gap: CRS integration account reads every guest profile hub table; 11 PMS accounts with card display and no documented need

control_description: Physical security inherited from cloud and colocation providers; badge access to property IT rooms
Certified media destruction; disposal procedure (POL-04 4.7)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Property edge firewalls from group templates; vendor access through PAM
gap: Legacy POS vendor always-on remote tool outside PAM

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encryption in transit; data loss prevention for email

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on hotel workstations and servers; vendor anti-malware on legacy POS servers
gap: No group EDR or SOC alerting on legacy POS servers

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability and hardening scans of property systems; annual penetration test
gap: Lock server default passwords at 14 hotels; lock servers outside hardening scans

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SOC monitoring of PMPS sources
gap: Legacy POS servers not SIEM sources

control_description: Triage and severity rating on the group scale
Card compromise playbook and owner notice steps (P08)
gap: Owner notice steps and the cross-division matrix not exercised

control_description: Recovery procedures and lessons learned
Change management with approval, testing, and separation of duties
BIA and continuity plans (P05); cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Oversight of the PMS, cloud POS, legacy POS, lock, and gateway vendors
control_owner: Group Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
gap: Legacy POS vendor support service not covered by any assurance report

control_description: Capacity monitoring for cloud and SaaS services
Immutable backups in Cloud provider B; provider resilience
Recovery tests for the PMS tenant, cloud POS, and property connectivity
control_owner: Hotels division payments and systems director
evidence: PMS vendor test report; SD-WAN failover tests
gap: Restores of legacy POS servers are done by the vendor and never tested by the group

gap: Card authorization forms in email at 21 managed hotels
